_doc: A blank skeleton to start a new body from scratch: copy it to bodies/<new id>.json, write what makes the subject itself here (silhouette, proportions, signature features, stance), set its height, then add the shapes. A biped about 40 body units tall; a four-legged body adds a second leg pair (phase 180, pole [0,-1,0] for a front elbow) and moves its points. Not a creature: nothing uses it.
